summary.name: GiftHuntr
summary.one_liner: GiftHuntr is an AI gift idea generator where you pick who the gift is for, their interests, occasion and budget, and it suggests gift ideas you can shop.
use_cases: Finding a birthday gift for a friend or partner
Choosing an anniversary or wedding present
Getting gift ideas for a hobbyist or pet owner
Shopping for a baby shower or new baby gift
Finding a gift within a set budget in rupees
summary.what_it_does: The page provides a form to select the recipient (man, woman, boy, girl, baby boy, baby girl, couple), age from 1 to 99, and multiple interest categories spanning hobbies, food and drink, pets, music, nature, sports, and travel. Users can also choose an occasion (such as birthday, anniversary, Christmas, or wedding) and a budget band in rupees, from under ₹10 up to under ₹1000, or no budget. A Find Gifts button then produces gift ideas. Navigation links include gift pages for her, him, boys, girls, babies, couples, golfers and cooks, plus a Trending Gifts section and a Gifts by Instagram section. The page text does not describe how the ideas are generated beyond the meta description, which says personalised ideas can be shopped instantly.
notable: Filters by recipient, age, interests, occasion and budget in Indian rupees
Listed as free in the hanishrao/collective-ai-tools directory
Includes Trending Gifts and Gifts by Instagram sections
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing marks it as free
Budget ranges are shown only in rupees and the highest band is under ₹1000
Page text gives few details on how ideas are generated or how shopping links work
